name: Ichijou Manami
source:
Daugther of Sara and Shinji. Sister of Miyuki.

In Shin Nozokima:
A cheerful girl that helps Ryouta when he moves into the residence
[spoiler]She knows about Ryouta skills and helps him as long as he helps her family[/spoiler]

In Shin Nozokima 2:
The only one of the family left in the residence after it turned into a students/teachers residence.
She still likes Ryouta, but she is jealous because he is always with other girls.
